decision_basis: Exact WNT9A-FZD9/Fzd9b-LRP6 cell-based and receptor-dependent relay/function supports qualified-high promotion; preserve zebrafish Fzd9b versus human FZD9, EGFR cofactor, LRP6-dependence, and no native purified ternary-binding or terminal-TF claim.

Exact WNT9B-FZD5-LRP6-dependent canonical function supports qualified-high promotion; preserve the single mouse nephron-progenitor-like model, RSPO1 context, LRP6 knockdown/non-rescue semantics, and absence of purified ternary binding or terminal-TF evidence.
